source: Battery power must be enabled before attempting to drive this locomotive.
target: 在尝试驾驶此机车之前，必须先开启蓄电池电源。

source: Brake Valve Conflict. Only one Brake Key should be unlocked at a time.
target: 制动阀冲突。一次只能解锁一把制动钥匙。

source: Close the LZB/PZB Cut-Off Valve to release the emergency brake when the Circuit Breaker is Open.
target: 当断路器断开时，关闭 LZB/PZB 隔离开关以缓解紧急制动。

source: Close the Main Circuit Breaker to draw power from the overhead wires.
target: 合上主断路器以从接触网获取电源。

source: Close the Sifa Cut-Off Valve to release the emergency brake when the Circuit Breaker is Open.
target: 当断路器断开时，关闭 Sifa 隔离开关以缓解紧急制动。

source: Hold the Electric Train Supply in START for one second to request ETS from the locomotive and keep coach batteries charged.
target: 将列车供电开关保持在“启动”位置 1 秒，以请求机车向列车供电并维持车厢蓄电池充电。

source: MU Train Control Fault. Only one cab can be active and all locomotives must have compatible modes.
target: 重联列车控制故障。仅能激活一个司机室，且所有机车必须具备兼容的模式。

source: MU Train Control is indicating that the brakes (Air Brake or Parking Brake) have not released on the rear vehicle.
target: 重联列车控制显示尾部车辆的制动（空气制动或停放制动）尚未缓解。

source: Move the Brake Key to UNLOCKED to use the Train Brake.
target: 将制动钥匙打到“解锁”位置以使用列车制动。

source: Set the Throttle to OFF to release the traction lock.
target: 将牵引手柄置于“关”位以解除牵引锁定。

source: The Pantograph must be raised before attempting to drive this locomotive.
target: 尝试驾驶此机车前必须升起受电弓。

source: Train Data panel is in Basic Data mode. Speed will be limited until a valid train data is input.
target: 列车数据面板处于基本数据模式。在输入有效的列车数据之前，速度将被限制。

source: Wait until the Power Converters have finished starting up before drawing power.
target: 在取电前，请等待变流器完成启动。

source: ZWS must be enabled on both the locomotive and control car to allow push-pull traction.
target: 机车和控制车上都必须启用 ZWS 以进行推挽牵引。
